title: Close or keep going?

predict.q: Fixed cost 360, so the shutdown loss is 360. The price falls to 15, below minimum AC (26) but above minimum AVC (10). Best short-run choice?

options.s: Shut down at once: a loss-making firm should always close
options.fb: Closing does not end the loss: fixed costs (360) are still paid. At 15 the firm covers its variable costs (220) and 80 of the fixed cost, so it loses only 280.
Producing 20 units loses 280; shutting loses 360. The firm covers its variable costs and part of the fixed cost.

options.s: Produce more than that, to spread the fixed cost
options.fb: Units beyond MC = P cost more than they earn: they make the loss bigger, not smaller.

task: Move the **Price** slider down to 15, then below 10, and compare "loss if producing" with "loss if shut".

target.do: Move the price slider to 15, then press Check.

takeaway: Produce as long as P ≥ AVC. Below 10, shutting down loses less.
